purpose: Teach: もどっ/はさん/つくし/心中/少く/いれる/前もって/申しわけ

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが急いでお家にもどって下さるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, your dad said he'd rush home early today.
lines.style: Warm, gentle announcement with a slight smile beneath. Even pace, encouraging — like sharing good news with someone who worries. Soft openness in the voice.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、絵本にしおりをはさんで読んでるよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I'm reading my picture book with a bookmark in it.
lines.style: Bright, eager report — wants credit for doing it right. Quick words, proud of himself. The small voice of a child showing off something grown-up.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが春につくしを採って下さるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, your dad said he'll collect tsukushi for us in spring.
lines.style: Thoughtful, dreamy quality. Voice softens with the promise of spring. Gentle pacing — inviting him into the future with her. Trailing warmth at the end.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、お父さんは心中、メイ姉さんを尊敬されてるって
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad secretly thinks you're really admirable, you know.
lines.style: Quiet, matter-of-fact delivery of an observation. No performance — just what he's noticed. Slight wonder in his voice, like he's still figuring out what he overheard.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お野菜の摂取が少くならないようにね
lines.en: Sho, let's make sure you're eating enough vegetables, okay?
lines.style: Gentle guideline, not a scolding. Practical care wrapped in warmth. Slight pause before 'okay' — inviting his agreement, not demanding it.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんとコーヒーをいれる練習したよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I practiced making coffee with Dad today.
lines.style: Bright achievement in his voice. Quick, energetic words — can't wait to tell her. Pride mixed with the novelty of doing something Dad does.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お出かけは前もって計画しましょうね
lines.en: Sho, let's plan our outings ahead of time from now on, alright?
lines.style: Steady, matter-of-fact instruction. Not sharp — kind, but clear about what she's asking. A future-looking tone, like she's learning how to ask for what she needs.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、ママに「申しわけない」って言えたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I told Mom I was sorry — and I really meant it.
lines.style: Quiet pride and relief. Slower pace — he's proud of the emotional work, not rushing past it. Soft but solid conviction underneath.
